page: Microsoft Azure DC8eds_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes 472 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for integration with high-speed external storage volumes. It does not include any bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC8eds_v6 provides dedicated compute resources and local storage capacity, balancing compute power with memory density. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as database management, memory-sensitive applications, and general-purpose enterprise tasks requiring dedicated CPU allocation and local disk space.
